about_short_description.short_description: SFOX is a cryptocurrency prime dealer for professional traders and institutional investors.

product.name: sFOX Trading Platform
product.description: A crypto trading platform aggregating liquidity from over 30 providers across 80+ markets, offering multiple order types and execution algorithms for institutional traders.

product.name: sFOX SAFE Custody
product.description: A regulated, insured, and bankruptcy-protected digital asset custody service providing secure storage and integrated trading and staking capabilities.

product.name: sFOX Connect
product.description: An API-driven platform enabling businesses to integrate end-to-end crypto services including onboarding, trading, staking, custody, and compliance.

product.name: sFOX Staking
product.description: A service allowing clients to participate in on-chain staking directly from custody to earn rewards on supported digital assets.

product.name: sFOX Prime Services
product.description: A suite of capital and operational services including credit lines, flexible settlement, clearing, and post-trade reporting for institutional clients.
